_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. endless.app declares a shadcn-style token layer in its Tailwind v4 theme — semantic roles that re-bind under .dark, the --mode-*/--label-*/--chart-*/--series-* product palettes, and Tailwind's own type/radius/container/ease scales. Declared variables become var leaves resolved per theme; font stacks, the card shadow, the focus ring and component geometry are measured leaves from raw/components-computed.json.

sans.description: TikTok Sans: the product face everywhere — headings, body, nav and buttons.

mono.description: Geist Mono: code snippets, the MCP install command and numeric/readout text.

display.description: The home hero display size (59.2px — a fluid clamp, not a declared step).
The display leading as a length (63.9px on 59.2px).

tighter.description: Declared --tracking-tighter = -.05em (em tracking scales with font size; the value here is the 16px-base equivalent).

tight.description: Declared --tracking-tight = -.025em (em tracking scales with font size; the value here is the 16px-base equivalent).

display.$description: The home hero display (59.2px medium, tight tracking).

accent.description: Endless sky #01bcff: the brand accent, focus ring and chart/label seed.

ring.description: The focus/interactive ring (same value as accent).

md.description: Declared --radius-md (8px): nav links, small buttons, fields.

2xl.description: Declared --radius-2xl (20px): the composer, model cards, brand tiles.

icon.description: The app-icon corner radius (22.5%, the Apple icon mask).

pill.description: The fully-round pill on filter chips and the billing toggle (the browser computes rounded-full as 3.35544e+07px; stored here as the practical 9999px).

base.description: The Tailwind spacing unit (4px); all gutters are multiples of it.

card.description: The floating-card elevation (a 1px 6% keyline ring plus 1px/2px umbrae): composer, tool panel, plan CTA.

focus-ring.description: The 3px 30% accent ring buttons paint on keyboard focus (plus an accent border).

dropdown.description: Declared dropdown/menu z-index (40); the sticky header also paints z-40.

focus-ring.source: computed focus-visible borderTopColor of nav-signin, nav-cta, send-btn == --ring (raw/components-computed.json)
focus-ring.description: The keyboard focus ring: the accent sky #01bcff as a 3px 30% ring plus an accent border.

focus-ring-width.source: computed boxShadow spread of nav-signin focus-visible (raw/components-computed.json)

field-fill.description: The translucent field fill the contact/tool inputs paint (≈47% neutral grey).

header-veil.description: The sticky header's translucent veil (≈90% page field, backdrop-blurred).

link-transition.description: The 150ms colour transition on nav links and buttons. (color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color, fil)
